reaction: Seeing the straight and bent arm alongside the supply and return routes tied the chapter together.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the lymph route was most worthwhile: I could follow excess fluid from around cells through vessels and back to a vein, and learn when it is called lymph.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the larger lymph vessels to the vein was a bit routine on its own, although the valve panels explained how fluid moves forward.

surprise.text: I didn't expect fluid around cells to have a separate vessel route back to the blood. The continuous route made its purpose clearer.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless: the pictures and goals explained the connections, though the later moves were the only available combinations rather than choices I had to figure out.

continue.text: I would probably try another chapter to see how another body system connects to this model. The lymph route gave me something new to follow, though the final combinations were quite guided.
